maddeler.e:
أنعصر (form VII)
# أَنْعَصِرُ (ʔanʕaṣiru) /ʔan.ʕa.sˤi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْعَصَرَ (inʕaṣara)
# أَنْعَصِرَ (ʔanʕaṣira) /ʔan.ʕa.sˤi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَصَرَ (inʕaṣara)
# أَنْعَصِرْ (ʔanʕaṣir) /ʔan.ʕa.sˤir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْعَصَرَ (inʕaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
